foundation_name: Evidence-Bound Vertical AI Planning Foundation V1
responsibility: Design evidence-first Vertical AI planning that turns repository understanding into reproducible plans without repository mutation

components.name: Goal Analysis
components.responsibility: Analyze active goal truth against repository understanding evidence so planning starts from certified goals, not invented intent.

components.name: Planning Context
components.responsibility: Assemble a read-only planning context from Platform Core, CIL, Repository Intelligence, and Project Understanding Runtime outputs without owning source data.

components.name: Candidate Generation
components.responsibility: Generate plan candidates from gaps and understanding evidence; candidates prefer reuse surfaces and never execute repository writes.

components.name: Reuse Planning
components.responsibility: Prioritize reuse-plan steps over create-plan steps; enforces reuse-before-create for every candidate that reaches implementation planning.

components.name: Implementation Planning
components.responsibility: Shape implementation plan descriptors only after reuse planning; descriptors are design artifacts and do not authorize mutation.

components.name: Risk Analysis
components.responsibility: Identify planning risks (baseline drift, unapproved write, weak evidence, create-before-reuse) as evidence-bound risk records.

components.name: Execution Plan
components.responsibility: Compose an ordered execution plan for Agent Runtime handoff; the plan describes orchestration requests and never performs domain mutation itself.

components.name: Plan Validation
components.responsibility: Validate plan structure, evidence citations, reuse precedence, and gate readiness before any approval or runtime handoff.

components.name: Planning Evidence
components.responsibility: Bind fingerprints and refs so every plan conclusion is preceded by understanding and Platform Core evidence.

components.name: Plan Reproducibility
components.responsibility: Ensure identical evidence inputs yield identical plan fingerprints across dual runs; planning design must be deterministic.

components.name: Approval Gate
components.responsibility: Require explicit human approval before any write action arising from a plan; foundation/design planning runs remain read-only.

components.name: Plan Traceability
components.responsibility: Maintain evidence-to-plan traceability from goal analysis through candidates, reuse, risks, execution plan, and validation.
